sherry.centroid_source: top 10 faces by distance to solo bridal portrait

methodology.step_1: Built Sherry centroid from solo bridal portrait + 9 closest faces
methodology.step_2: Ranked ALL 328 non-Sherry Fader faces by L2 distance to Sherry centroid (kinship signal)
methodology.step_3: Clustered top 50 faces using <1.0 intra-cluster distance threshold
methodology.step_4: Visually reviewed cluster photos for age-appropriate women
methodology.step_5: Cross-referenced with event context (wedding, family gatherings) and temporal anchors
methodology.step_6: Compared recurring-person clusters across photos for consistency

cluster_1_young_women.assessment: Young women similar age to Sherry — likely friends or cousins. NOT Nellie candidates.

cluster_2_wedding_mother.assessment: D72A photo is CRITICAL — older woman in glasses/brocade handing bride the cake topper. Same person as parents portrait. Other photos in cluster are younger women — likely miscluster.

nellie_evidence.D72A1E71: Woman in glasses, brocade dress, pearls, long gloves handing Sherry cake topper figurine. SAME outfit as parents portrait and ceremony. Mother-of-bride behavior.

filenames: E4A0952B (Apr 67 baby photo — BUT this is Sherry, not the other person)
D3CA0B24 (Apr 64 street photo with glasses woman + children)
cluster_3_glasses_woman_outdoor.assessment: D3CA photo (Apr 64) shows woman with glasses on city street with Sherry and two children. Age ~55, one year before wedding. Glasses + build consistent with wedding photos. Could be Nellie in non-wedding context.

nellie_evidence.D3CA0B24: Dated Apr 1964. Woman with dark glasses, dark hair, ~55yo, standing with Sherry (~20) and two children on Brooklyn-looking street. Mother-daughter outing with grandchildren or young relatives.

cluster_11_wedding_formal.assessment: THIS IS THE KEY CLUSTER. Same older woman across 3 wedding photos: seated at head table, walking bride down aisle, dancing with groom. All classic mother-of-bride activities at Jewish wedding.

nellie_evidence.A08EAB11_head_table: Older woman with glasses, brocade dress seated at head table. Position to Ira's right could be non-traditional seating.
nellie_evidence.0FBD3088_ceremony: Same woman walking Sherry down the aisle — parent escort.
nellie_evidence.9A116A4C_dancing: Same woman (glasses, brocade full-length gown) dancing with Ira (groom). Mother-in-law/groom dance is traditional at Jewish weddings.
nellie_evidence.confidence: VERY HIGH — consistent person across 3 independent wedding contexts

consolidated_nellie_candidate.summary: One woman appears across AT LEAST 5 wedding photos in the same brocade/gold patterned dress with glasses, pearl necklace, and long white gloves. She performs mother-of-bride activities: corsage, walking bride down aisle, handing bride cake topper, dancing with groom.
consolidated_nellie_candidate.cross_cluster_note: Embedding system split this person across Clusters 2, 3, and 11. The intra-person distances are high (0.96-1.29) because: (a) age gap between 1964 casual and 1965 formal photos, (b) different lighting/angles, (c) glasses create embedding noise. But visual review confirms same person across all 5+ photos.

abraham_fader_candidate.description: Bald man in tuxedo with boutonniere in parents portrait (F8B131D2). Age ~64. Different from glasses/yarmulke man in ceremony (0FBD3088).

feature_ideas_from_methodology: Gemini API: classify event type from photo (wedding, party, casual, formal, outdoor)
Gemini API: estimate age of each person → filter by GEDCOM birth year
Gemini API: identify clothing/outfit matches across photos in same event
Gemini API: identify traditional role indicators (corsage, boutonniere, veil, party hat)
New signal: 'kinship embedding distance' — distance to known relative as soft indicator of family relationship
New signal: 'co-occurrence with known person' — appears in photos WITH confirmed person
New signal: 'age trajectory consistency' — same person should age consistently across dated photos
API format: structure all this as a Gemini API call with photo context, known people, family tree, and ask for identification suggestions
data_format_note: This investigation data should mirror gemini_api_calls table structure: prompt_text (the question), full_response (the analysis), context (family tree, known people, event info). Future: store as 'identification_investigations' in Supabase.
